# SifreleNet Cyber UI Kit — llms.txt

> A cyberpunk-aesthetic React component library for Next.js projects.
> All components are copied directly into your project via CLI — no hidden wrappers, full ownership.
> Showroom & live playground: https://sifrelenet.vercel.app

## Installation (CLI)

```bash
npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add <ComponentName>
# or: yarn dlx / pnpm dlx / bunx
```

The CLI copies the `.tsx` file into `components/cyber-ui/` and installs all dependencies automatically.

## Required CSS Setup

Add to `globals.css`:
```css
:root {
  --neon-green: #00ff9f;
  --neon-dim: #00cc7a;
  --surface: #0f0f0f;
  --border: #1a2e1a;
}
@keyframes blink { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0; } }
.animate-blink { animation: blink 1s step-end infinite; }
```

## Design System

All components share a consistent `variant` prop:
- `"green"` — Neon green (default, hacker aesthetic)
- `"cyan"` — Cyber cyan (tech HUD style)
- `"red"` — Warning red (threat / danger)
- `"amber"` — Alert amber (warning / stealth)

Import pattern: `import ComponentName from '@/components/cyber-ui/ComponentName';`

---

## Components

### PRIMITIVES

**CyberButton**
Cyberpunk neon button with cut-corner, glitch hover and glow effects.
Props: `variant`, `size` (sm|md|lg), `isCutCorner` (bool), `glitchOnHover` (bool), `glow` (bool), `onClick`, `children`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberButton`

**CyberInput**
Terminal-styled text input with prompt prefix and neon focus glow.
Props: `variant`, `prompt` (string, e.g. "root@kali:~#"), `glow` (bool), `placeholder`, `value`, `onChange`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberInput`

**CyberPanel**
Frosted-glass terminal panel with title bar, status LED and resize controls.
Props: `variant`, `title` (string), `status` (string), `showControls` (bool), `glow` (bool), `children`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberPanel`

**CyberBadge**
Inline monospace badge with optional bracket styling.
Props: `variant`, `brackets` (bool), `children`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberBadge`

**GlitchText**
Text that glitches with RGB-shift and scanline artifacts.
Props: `text` (string), `trigger` (hover|always), `glow` (bool), `className`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add GlitchText`

**CyberStatusLine**
Terminal status bar line with status text, detail count and address.
Props: `status`, `detail`, `count`, `address`, `stateColor` (variant)
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberStatusLine`

**CyberActionCard**
Compact action card with label, value and terminal command preview.
Props: `label`, `value`, `command`, `description`, `icon`, `variant`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberActionCard`

**CyberConsoleBox**
Terminal command + output display box.
Props: `command` (string), `content` (string), `variant`, `glow` (bool)
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberConsoleBox`

**CyberTabs**
Scanline-styled tab navigation bar.
Props: `tabs` ([{id, label, count?}]), `activeTabId` (string), `onChange` (fn), `variant`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberTabs`

**CyberSwitch**
Toggle switch with retro LED and scanning line animation.
Props: `checked` (bool), `onChange` (fn), `label` (string), `variant`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberSwitch`

**CyberCheckbox**
Monospace checkbox with bracket styling and glitch check mark.
Props: `checked` (bool), `onChange` (fn), `label` (string), `variant`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberCheckbox`

**CyberDialog**
Modal dialog with framer-motion entrance and neon border. Depends on: CyberButton.
Props: `isOpen` (bool), `onClose` (fn), `title` (string), `variant`, `actions` (ReactNode), `children`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberDialog`

**CyberProgress**
Retro block progress bar or modern neon line progress.
Props: `value` (0-100), `label` (string), `type` (block|line), `variant`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberProgress`

**CyberAlert**
System alert box with icon, action button and child message. Depends on: CyberBadge, CyberButton.
Props: `title` (string), `variant`, `onAction` (fn), `actionText` (string), `children`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberAlert`

---

### ADVANCED

**CyberTable**
Monospace data table with CRT scanline overlay and telemetry title bar.
Props: `title`, `subtitle`, `variant`, `columns` ([{key, header}]), `data` ([{...}])
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberTable`

**CyberTooltip**
Neon bracketed tooltip with configurable position.
Props: `content` (string), `position` (top|bottom|left|right), `variant`, `delay` (ms), `children`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberTooltip`

**CyberToast**
Provider + hook-based toast notification system with progress countdown.
Usage: Wrap app in `<CyberToastProvider>`, then use `const { toast } = useCyberToast()` inside components.
`toast({ title, message, variant, duration? })`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberToast`

**CyberCommandMenu**
Spotlight-style ⌘K command palette overlay with keyboard navigation and search.
Props: `triggerKey` (string, e.g. "k"), `options` ([{id, category, title, subtitle?, action}])
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberCommandMenu`

**CyberAccordion**
Collapsible accordion sections with bracket toggle indicators.
Props: `variant`, `allowMultiple` (bool), `items` ([{id, trigger, content}])
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberAccordion`

**CyberSlider**
HUD-style range slider with gradient fill and tick labels.
Props: `label`, `min`, `max`, `step?`, `value`, `onChange`, `variant`, `showTicks` (bool)
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberSlider`

**CyberOtpInput**
One-time password input boxes with neon bracket corners. Supports paste.
Props: `length` (number, default 6), `value` (string), `onChange` (fn), `variant`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberOtpInput`

**CyberSkeleton**
CRT signal sweep loading placeholder for content loading states.
Props: `className` (string, e.g. "w-full h-12"), `variant`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberSkeleton`

**CyberBreadcrumb**
Terminal path breadcrumb navigator with ~ home prefix.
Props: `variant`, `items` ([{label, href?}])
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberBreadcrumb`

**CyberDropdown**
Custom select dropdown with neon corner brackets and option check marks.
Props: `value` (string), `onChange` (fn), `variant`, `placeholder`, `options` ([{value, label}])
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberDropdown`

---

### ANIMATIONS

**MatrixRain**
Animated Japanese katakana / binary / hex falling characters canvas.
Props: `color` (CSS color), `speed` (number), `fontSize` (px), `opacity` (0-1), `charType` (all|katakana|binary|hex)
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add MatrixRain`

**CyberPulseRadar**
Animated sonar / radar sweep with grid rings and blip targets.
Props: `variant`, `speed` (seconds per sweep), `showGrid` (bool)
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberPulseRadar`

**TextDecryptor**
Text scramble animation that reveals the real text character by character.
Props: `text` (string), `speed` (ms per char), `trigger` (mount|hover|click), `variant`, `glow` (bool), `className`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add TextDecryptor`

**HologramContainer**
Glassmorphism hologram wrapper with CRT scanlines, flicker and noise effects.
Props: `variant`, `flicker` (bool), `scanlines` (bool), `noise` (bool), `className`, `children`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add HologramContainer`

---

### TEMPLATES (full page sections)

**CyberLoginForm**
Full authentication form with terminal typing animation, progress bar and error handling.
Props: `onSuccess` (fn: (username: string) => void)
Dependencies: CyberButton, CyberInput, CyberAlert, CyberProgress, framer-motion, lucide-react
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberLoginForm`

**CyberSignupForm**
Registration form with password strength meter and terms checkbox.
Props: `onSuccess` (fn: (data: {username, email}) => void)
Dependencies: CyberButton, CyberInput, CyberCheckbox, CyberAlert, CyberProgress
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberSignupForm`

**CyberSystemDashboard**
Live-animated system metrics dashboard with CPU, RAM, disk and process monitors.
No required props. Self-contained with animated fake data.
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberSystemDashboard`

**CyberDataForm**
Multi-tab configuration form with inputs, switches, checkboxes and submit logic.
No required props.
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add CyberDataForm`

**InteractiveConsole**
Fully functional terminal emulator with command history and built-in commands (help, ls, whoami, etc.)
No required props.
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add InteractiveConsole`

**TargetNetworkMap**
Animated network topology map with node discovery and packet animation.
No required props.
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add TargetNetworkMap`

**TerminalHero**
Full-screen hero section with animated terminal typing effect and mission badge.
Props: `title`, `subtitle`, `badgeText`, `loopAnimation` (bool)
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add TerminalHero`

**HackerDashboard**
Animated hacker-style dashboard with live scan tickers and Matrix rain background.
Props: `scanInterval?`, `logInterval?`, `bruteInterval?`, `hexInterval?` (all in ms)
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add HackerDashboard`

**ProjectCard**
Cyberpunk project showcase card with tags, status badge and year.
Props: `title`, `description`, `tags` (string[]), `status` (active|beta|archived), `year`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add ProjectCard`

**SkillsSection**
Terminal skill list with animated scan progress bars.
Props: `title`, `commandPrefix`
Install: `npx sifrelenet-ui-kit add SkillsSection`

## MCP Server

For AI agents that support MCP (Model Context Protocol), run the server to enable active component browsing and installation:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "sifrelenet-ui-kit": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["node_modules/sifrelenet-ui-kit/cli/mcp-server.js"]
    }
  }
}
```

Available MCP tools:
- `list-components` — list all components, optionally filter by category
- `get-component-info` — get props, deps and usage for a specific component
- `add-component` — install a component into the current project
- `get-install-command` — get the install command without running it
